review.subject: Eau de toilette perfume bottles on a Mediterranean seaside rock with lemons
review.summary: A slow CGI fragrance spot: the camera glides through foreground leaves toward a bottle on a coastal rock, pushes in to the bottle with a lemon half, pulls back to a full sea view with reflection, and dissolves into a blue logo card. It uses only five long shots.

beats.note: Leaves foreground over cliffs and sea, camera moves through foliage.
Bottle appears behind leaves as camera pushes in.
Close on bottle label and lemon half on pebbles.
Pull-out to bottles on rock by water with reflection.
Water-blue brand card with logo and product name.

shot_labels.note: Out-of-focus bottle, leaves, sea stacks, push through foliage
Bottle behind leaves, push-in and pan
Bottle label with lemon half, slow push-in
Full still life on rock by sea, push-in
Logo on water texture, static hold

learn: Use five long shots (2.4-3.4s each) for a calm luxury rhythm.
Layer foreground leaves to create depth and hide the bottle until a rack of focus reveals it.
Move from distant world to label close-up to a final wide so the bottle is seen three ways.
Dissolve into a water-texture end card and hold the logo for 3.4s.
Tie the palette to the product: blue sea, white pebbles and yellow lemon accents.
